qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Premier UK direct motor insurer with low-cost scale economies shared advantage and exceptional underwriting agility. 24.5% median ROIC, combined ratio ~85-90%, interest coverage >40x, and Solvency II ratio ~193-203%. qualitative.evidence: Admiral commands ~15% of the UK private motor insurance market. Over the last 4 years, reported GAAP ROIC averaged 24.5% (tangible ROIC 28.1%). During the 2022-2023 UK claims inflation spike, Admiral raised rates aggressively ahead of the market, temporarily sacrificing policy volume to preserve underwriting margins; by 2024-2025, operating profit and EPS rebounded to all-time highs (£742.6M net income in FY25, EPS 243.3p). Solvency II ratio stands robust at ~193% post-dividend with interest coverage >40x.
